description: (Audit 2019) Congestion on all roads during 2016 AM peak is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Infrastructure Australia. This layer is part of strategic transport modelling undertaken for Urban Transport Crowding and Congestion, a supplementary report of the Australian Infrastructure Audit 2019. These data represent average weekday transport performance during AM peak (7am to 9am). Note that any network links below relevant daily volume thresholds are not included. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Infrastructure Australia. Its tags are congestion, crowding, transport, urban transport. It offers 5 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP, SLD, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
